summary: Smoke-tested Vireo Insurance Compare MVP (backend + frontend). All critical backend endpoints and quote math correct; primary frontend flow (category toggle -> quote -> compare -> side-by-side) works end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/quote (health, age32) returns 6 quotes sorted asc by premium [206.71,275.62,301.72,325.73,357.05,436.39]
Age scaling: life l_atlas age60=102.69 > age25=43.70
Frontend landing renders with Vireo brand, hero category switches (health/life), and QuoteForm card
Category toggle: switching to Life shows term-select and hides family-size-select
get-quote-btn triggers /api/quote and renders providers-grid with 6 provider-card-* elements, sorted by lowest premium (visible: $207, $276, $302 in screenshot)

Selecting 2 cards shows sticky-compare-bar; compare-selected-btn opens side-by-side-modal displaying both plans in columns (monthly premium, annual, deductible, max OOP, network, rating, features, exclusions)
No error elements found on page; only a11y warning about missing DialogContent Description (non-blocking)

failed.issue: Age display did not update when using ArrowRight keyboard events after focusing [data-testid="age-slider"] (value stayed at '32 years'). Likely because Radix Slider requires focus on the thumb element rather than the root. Slider still works via mouse drag in normal use.
failed.evidence: Playwright: age_before='32 years' age_after='32 years' after 5x ArrowRight

failed.issue: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby on ProviderModal and SideBySide modals
failed.evidence: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ProviderModal and SideBySide to remove Radix a11y warnings
Optional: expose a data-testid on the slider thumb for keyboard-driven E2E tests (functional behavior is fine)
